title: Scene registration & routing: manifest → generated products.tsx → scenes.ts/appScenes.ts → sceneLogic
answers: How do I register a new scene?
Where are routes and urls defined for product scenes?
How does sceneLogic load a scene?
body:
Pieces (core scenes hand-written; product scenes via manifest):
- `frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts:Scene` enum (value must match scene's first exported component name, for chunk preloading); `SceneExport` = {component, logic?, paramsToProps?, productKey?, emptyState?}.
- `frontend/src/scenes/urls.ts:urls` = `{...productUrls, ...}`.
- `frontend/src/scenes/scenes.ts`: `sceneConfigurations` (spreads `productConfiguration`), `redirects` (`productRedirects`), `routes` path->[Scene, urlKey] (`productRoutes`).
- `frontend/src/scenes/appScenes.ts:appScenes` Scene -> lazy import, starts with `...productScenes`.
- `products/<name>/manifest.tsx` exports `manifest: ProductManifest` (urls, scenes{name,import}, routes, fileSystemTypes). Example: products/actions/manifest.tsx.
- `frontend/build-products.mjs` (`pnpm build:products`) generates `frontend/src/products.tsx`, `productScenes.tsx`, `products.json` (DO NOT EDIT). Dynamic imports are split into productScenes.tsx so jest --findRelatedTests doesn't over-match.
Runtime: `frontend/src/scenes/sceneLogic.tsx:sceneLogic` urlToAction from `routes` → `loadScene` listener → `props.scenes[sceneId]` (appScenes) with retryImport, spinner after 500ms → reads module's `scene` export; unknown → Scene.Error404.
Example scene export: products/actions/frontend/pages/Actions.tsx `scene: SceneExport`.

search: Scene registration flow from product manifest to runtime scene loading: manifest.tsx → pnpm build:products → generated products.tsx and productScenes.tsx → scenes.ts routes and appScenes lazy imports → sceneLogic runtime resolver. Core scenes are hand-written; product scenes are generated from products/<name>/manifest.tsx. SceneExport must export component and optional logic/paramsToProps/productKey/emptyState. At runtime, sceneLogic uses retryImport to load the module from appScenes, then reads the scene export; unknown Scene IDs fall back to Scene.Error404. Paths: frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts:Scene and SceneExport, scenes.ts:routes and sceneConfigurations, appScenes.ts, sceneLogic.tsx, frontend/build-products.mjs, products/<name>/manifest.tsx.
